_comment: Browser interaction probes for the creo-perf harness (fe-interactions.mjs). One entry per SCENARIO_FE key. Actions: click | type (+text, delay) | fill (+text) | press | hover | select (+value) | wait (ms) | waitFor (selector) | goto (path). `rows` = selector counted during the refetch (min rendered rows; 0 = the view blanks). `apiPattern` = regex of requests counted. Needs playwright resolvable from PERF_APP_DIR.
